name: Node-RED

lifecycle.note: A v2 shared recipe configures bcrypt-backed adminAuth before startup and its adapter verifies the saved administrator against the Admin API. Fresh-image startup, nested settings-file mount behavior, browser editing, and restart persistence remain unverified. Node-RED issues expiring Admin API access tokens, not a persistent API key.

security: Configure adminAuth with a bcrypt-hashed password in /data/settings.js before exposing the editor or Admin API.
Review contributed nodes and every credential or host integration used by flows.
pitfalls: The default settings file does not enable editor or Admin API authentication; private port binding alone is not administrator setup.
POST /auth/token returns an expiring access token; do not hand it off as a durable API key.
A flow editor can become a broad control plane without clear ownership.
